listing.name: Free Safety Overrides
listing.summary: Makes Safety Overrides free and able to be installed on capitals.
listing.aiSummary: Makes safety overrides free to install on capital ships and removes their range and power-to-heat penalties.

description: Allows safety overrides to be installed on capital ships at no cost. It also eliminates the usual reductions to weapon range and power-to-heat ratios associated with these modules.
